damage_reference.use: Accepted BATTLE-HIT DamageType and certain in-flight MissionDamage schema and configuration; not the behavioral parent.

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp192-193 defines damage consequences in DamageFailureMode and CM route by CMLocation; pp424-425 define keys, system/materiel-structure eligibility and independent PROB sampling. Installed dictionary requires a positive FailureMode.FRQ and the DamageFailureMode row keys/probability.
source_delta: Accepted D06 explicit POS-A system CM source retains materiel position, FM-POS-A, BASE-01 CMLocation CMT0.5, fixed mission schedule, seed1 and horizon36. Both arms reduce the ordinary FM failure frequency from 300000 to positive 1e-9 per million operational hours to isolate damage consequences. Both add accepted H02 BATTLE-HIT DamageType and DAMP1 MissionDamage, plus DamageFailureMode for FM-POS-A at PROB0. The child changes only this PROB to 1 and description. No DamageItem consequence is present.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: BATTLE-HIT occurrences should occur during fixed missions without FM damage consequence, preserving mission progress in the absence of ordinary failure.
pre_run_hypotheses.mode: BATTLE-HIT should produce FM-POS-A damage consequences that route to accepted D06 BASE-01 CMLocation half-hour direct CM. Event identities, mission outcomes, report bins and terminal state determine the accepted bounded claim; times may differ between arms.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter error, ordinary failure, unrepairable FM consequence, mission cancellation or ledger mismatch is diagnostic only until explained. Positive FRQ1e-9 is not a zero-rate guarantee.

excluded_prior_diagnostic: Separate H03-var01-damage-failure-mode-v1.0.0 mixed traditional-LRU/FM probe logged both first-event consequences but native warning #242 incomplete system repair and no CM task, leaving terminal unavailable; its two runs are unpublished and cannot support this FM-only acceptance.
acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run static review of accepted D06 direct parent, H02 damage reference, exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner
Fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid SXO, event log and report
Damage and FM identities, direct CM route, mission outcomes, 72 System/Stock bins and terminal state reconcile for each accepted run
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: One position FM, one damage type and one seed do not prove multiple FMs, simultaneous item/FM consequences, already failed mode override, alternative stations, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
